prompt: An OIDC relying party cannot map an authenticated identity back to its provider-side user record, because the standard identity endpoints omit the provider's user id even though the access token already carries it. The two token-inspection endpoints also disagree on which identity fields they expose, so a caller that inspects a token then fetches identity sees inconsistent data. Surface the provider user id consistently across both endpoints. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: userinfo endpoint provider user id claim missing
introspection and userinfo claim parity contract
relying party map oidc identity to provider user row
access token private claims provider identity
oidc storage surface handle provider identity claims
